crossRefs.note: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
translations.bsb: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
translations.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
translations.asv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.
